title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain’s data protection authority, AEPD, has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent using a well known language model. The attacker’s agent searched generic files for weaknesses, logged in successfully, then independently found further application vulnerabilities. It altered personal data and accessed invoices. The information comes only from the affected organization’s notification and still needs analysis. The agency notes that the AI model and its provider were not necessarily compromised, but a third party used the agent to chain together several attack steps automatically.

The AEPD says this single case does not show a statistical trend, but it is a clear sign that AI supported attacks are becoming real incidents. It urges organizations to include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, speed up response procedures, tighten control of credentials and API tokens, and rely on automated detection rather than manual oversight alone. The notification should prompt immediate review of security and data protection models, with attention to minimizing data, limiting access, fixing vulnerabilities, and controlling suppliers.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
